mcp_tools.name: observability_and_runbook_design
mcp_tools.title: Observability and runbook design
mcp_tools.description: Submits an observability and runbook design record (signals and dashboards, alert design and runbook linkage, runbook content and failure modes, incident flow and postmortem, backups/silent failure and red lines) and returns a deterministic OBSERVABILITY_DESIGN_SOUND / OBSERVABILITY_DESIGN_NOT_SOUND / INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE verdict across five sections, including computed per-alert and per-failure-mode coverage checks, with per-check evidence. Audits the declared design record; it monitors no live system.

inputSchema.description: The observability and runbook design manifest (see the atom's SERVICE.md for the field table and row schemas).

alerts.description: Declared alerts: {name, owner, runbook_linked, actionable, symptom_based}.

failure_modes.description: Declared failure modes: {name, runbook_present, symptoms_described, check_steps_present, mitigation_present, escalation_present, recovery_verification_present}.

expect.notes: All boolean flags are true (or false for red lines), lists are non-empty and fully populated. computed_spot_checks: alerts_count=1, failure_modes_count=1, owner_coverage=1.000000
